tests.title: Settings → Email: empty-state renders for admin
steps: Open the web app at http://localhost:3021
Sign in as franchisee@gmail.com (admin of Test Fitness Franchise)
Navigate to /dashboard/settings/email via the sidebar Settings → Email link
Confirm the Email page renders with the PageHeader 'Email'
Confirm the Sending domains card shows the empty-state message 'No sending domains yet'
Confirm the Add a sending domain card renders with Domain, From name, and Default local-part inputs

tests.title: Settings → Email: domain row renders with sender, status, and DNS records
steps: Setup (off-camera): a pending email_domains row is seeded (mail-e2e-seed.example.com, sender 'E2E Seed Sender', default local-part 'noreply', a representative DNS-records snapshot)
Open /dashboard/settings/email — the seeded row renders in the Sending domains table
Confirm the Sender cell shows 'E2E Seed Sender' + 'noreply@mail-e2e-seed.example.com'
Confirm the Status badge reads 'pending' and the Verified at column shows '—'
Click 'DNS records' to expand the row
The inline DNS table renders all four records: TXT (_resend verification), TXT (DKIM resend._domainkey), MX (send… priority 10, feedback-smtp.ap-southeast-1.amazonses.com), TXT (_dmarc)
The DMARC policy panel + Sending-address aliases panel render below the table — confirms the full expanded-row view an admin sees after registering

tests.title: Settings → Email: edit sender + delete domain
steps: With the seeded pending domain row visible (mail-e2e-seed.example.com, sender 'E2E Seed Sender <noreply@…>'), click Edit sender
Edit dialog opens preloaded with fromName='E2E Seed Sender' and localPart='noreply'
Change fromName to 'E2E Renamed Sender' and localPart to 'billing'
Confirm the live preview reads 'Will send as: E2E Renamed Sender <billing@mail-e2e-seed.example.com>'
Click Save — dialog closes and the row updates in place to 'E2E Renamed Sender' + 'billing@mail-e2e-seed.example.com'
Click Delete — the confirm dialog opens: 'Are you sure you want to delete the sending domain mail-e2e-seed.example.com? This action cannot be undone.'

Click Delete to confirm — the Resend.domains.remove call surfaces the expected error toast 'Failed to delete domain at Resend; please retry.' because the seeded synthetic resend_domain_id isn't registered at Resend; the row remains in DB (documented error-path behavior — the UI correctly reports the upstream failure rather than silently dropping the row)
Edit→save→update is fully exercised end-to-end; delete exercises the confirm-dialog + error-path. Clean DB delete + return-to-empty-state is covered by test #1.

tests.title: Settings → Email: Send test button gating + dialog flow on verified domain
steps: Sign in as franchisee@gmail.com (admin of Test Fitness Franchise)
Seed a status='verified' email_domains row for the org (e2e-verified.example.com, default_local_part='support', from_name='E2E Verified Sender')
Navigate to /dashboard/settings/email
Confirm verified row renders with status badge 'verified' and verified_at timestamp
Confirm 'Send test' button in Actions column is enabled (was disabled for pending/verifying rows)
Click 'Send test' — Send test email dialog opens with title 'Send test email — e2e-verified.example.com'
Confirm recipient input prefills with current session user email (franchisee@gmail.com)
Confirm From-line preview reads 'E2E Verified Sender <support@e2e-verified.example.com>'
Leave alias label blank and submit — server proc POST /rpc/emailDomains/sendTest fires

Server correctly rejects with 'Resend API error: The e2e-verified.example.com domain is not verified' (expected: the seeded synthetic resend_domain_id isn't registered at Resend) — the descriptive error surfaces in the toast in the recording
useApiMutation.onError fires — proc-gating + UI flow chain validated end-to-end
Cancel dialog, flip row to status='pending' via SQL, reload
Confirm 'Send test' button is now disabled with title 'Verify the domain first' — UI gating works
NOTE: Real-send success path requires a domain actually verified at Resend (DNS records added). UI gating + proc dispatch path validated.

tests.title: Auth: magic-link sign-in dispatches through tenant-aware sender
steps: Pre-seed a status='verified' email_domains row (e2e-verified.example.com) for the franchisee's org so the tenant route exists
Logged out, open /sign-in-link — the 'Sign in by email' magic-link form renders
Type franchisee@gmail.com into the Email field
Click 'Send sign-in link' — POST /api/auth/sign-in/magic-link fires
Observe the result toast surface in the notifications region ('Failed to send sign-in link')

VERIFICATION (server-side, captured in e2e-web/videos/test-5-server-log-proof.txt): the stack proves Object.sendMagicLink → dispatchAuthEmail (better-auth.ts:173) → sendTenantEmail (email-send-tenant.ts:178) ran FIRST (tenant route), then dispatchAuthEmail (better-auth.ts:196) → sendMagicLinkEmail (email.ts:595) ran SECOND (platform fallback). Both legs fire in order. The 'Failed to send sign-in link' toast is the expected Resend sandbox limit (only delivers to account owner, won't send from an un-DNS-verified domain), not a routing bug. Green-success leg needs a real DNS-verified domain and is deferred.

tests.title: Settings → Email: add and remove a sending-address alias
steps: Sign in as franchisee@gmail.com; seed a sending-domain row with DNS records
Navigate to /dashboard/settings/email and click 'DNS records' to expand the row
In the Sending-address aliases panel, confirm it starts at 'No aliases yet'
Type local-part 'billing' and label 'Billing dept', click Add alias
Toast 'Alias added.' appears; the alias table row shows billing · Billing dept · billing@mail-e2e-seed.example.com
Click Remove on the billing alias
Toast 'Alias removed.' appears and the panel returns to 'No aliases yet' — add + remove round-trip verified

tests.title: Settings → Email: DMARC progression reflects the _dmarc policy
steps: Seed a sending-domain row whose _dmarc TXT record is 'v=DMARC1; p=none;'
Open /dashboard/settings/email and expand DNS records
DMARC policy panel highlights 'Monitor' (p=none) with guidance 'Once reports look clean, move to p=quarantine'
Update the _dmarc record to p=quarantine (DNS-provider change, simulated via DB) and reload
Re-expand DNS: the stepper now highlights 'Quarantine' with blurb 'p=quarantine — failing mail goes to spam.' and guidance 'move to p=reject'
Confirms the panel parses p= live and advances the none → quarantine → reject stepper correctly

tests.title: Settings → Email: real domain registration hits the live Resend API
steps: [on camera] Open /dashboard/settings/email — empty state ('No sending domains yet')
[on camera] Fill Add a sending domain: domain e2e-demo.zhiyuantech.ai, from name 'Zhiyuan E2E Demo', default local-part 'noreply'
[on camera] Click Register domain — the create proc calls resend.domains.create against the LIVE Resend API; toast 'Domain registered.' + the row appears (status pending)

[on camera] Click DNS records — the table shows the REAL Resend-returned records: DKIM TXT (resend._domainkey, p=MIGf…), MX feedback-smtp.us-east-1.amazonses.com (pri 10), SPF (v=spf1 include:amazonses.com ~all)
[on camera] Click Delete → confirm dialog → Delete — the delete proc calls resend.domains.remove (live API); toast 'Sending domain removed.' and the page returns to 'No sending domains yet'

VERIFIED via Resend API (off camera): pre-run GET /domains = 0; after register = 1 (e2e-demo.zhiyuantech.ai, real id, region us-east-1) with the SAME id stored in the DB row; after delete = 0 + DB count 0 — the full register→dashboard→delete round-trip ran against live Resend
NOTE: domain stays 'not_started' / never verifies because the DNS records aren't added to the real zhiyuantech.ai zone — that DNS step is the only remaining real-domain action.

tests.title: Settings → Email: bind a notification type to an alias + from-name + subject override
steps: Sign in as franchisee@gmail.com (admin of Test Fitness Franchise — verified domain e2e-demo.zhiyuantech.ai + a 'billing' alias)

Open /dashboard/settings/email — the new 'Notification routing' card renders 5 rows (Member invitation, Payment receipt, Email verification, Password reset, Magic-link sign-in), each with an alias dropdown, From name + Subject override inputs, Save, a live 'Will send as' preview, and a subject-token hint
In the Payment receipt row, open the alias dropdown — lists 'Use domain default' + 'billing · Billing Department'
Select 'billing · Billing Department' — preview updates live to 'Will send as: Zhiyuan Mail <billing@e2e-demo.zhiyuantech.ai>' (fallback note disappears)
Type From name 'Acme Billing' + Subject override 'Receipt {amount}' — preview from-name updates live to 'Acme Billing'
Click Save — toast 'Routing saved.'; VERIFIED via DB: email_notification_routes row payment_receipt → billing alias, from_name_override 'Acme Billing', subject_override 'Receipt {amount}'

Reload — the row rehydrates with billing + 'Acme Billing' + 'Receipt {amount}' + the preview 'Acme Billing <billing@e2e-demo.zhiyuantech.ai>', and a Reset button now appears (shown only for bound rows)

Click Reset — toast 'Routing reset.'; the row reverts to 'Use domain default', empty inputs, Reset button gone, preview back to 'Zhiyuan Mail <noreply@e2e-demo.zhiyuantech.ai> (falls back to default sender)'. VERIFIED via DB: 0 route rows remain

NOTE: a live-preview reactivity bug (read form.state.values directly → never re-rendered) was found WHILE recording and fixed (moved into <form.Subscribe>) before this final take — the video shows the corrected, live-updating preview.

RESPONSIVE FIX (re-recorded): page horizontally overflowed (Sending-domains table action column forced the content column wide because dashboard <main> lacked min-w-0), clipping this card's left edge. Fixed: added min-w-0 to <main> (table scrolls inside its card) + made each routing row responsive (fields stack full-width below sm, original row on sm+). Verified 0px horizontal overflow at 1440px and mobile width; recording shows the corrected layout.
